# Bhavishya Singla — Architecture & Knowledge Base (`llms-full.txt`)

> Comprehensive overview of Bhavishya Singla's interactive portal, technical stack, integrated 3D experiences, and online presence.

## Identity & Mission
- **Name**: Bhavishya Singla
- **Focus**: Artificial Intelligence, Creative Engineering, and 3D Web Computing
- **Website**: https://bhavishyasingla.com
- **Philosophy**: "FIGURING THINGS OUT." An editorial, high-contrast, minimalist doorway into digital environments and interactive 3D WebGL experiences.

## Core Integrated 3D Experiences
All three experiences are actual open-source projects created by creative developer Bruno Simon, locally cloned, optimized, and integrated as independent 3D worlds.

### 1. My Room in 3D
- **URL**: https://bhavishyasingla.com/room
- **Source**: https://github.com/brunosimon/my-room-in-3d
- **Technology**: Three.js, Webpack 5, GSAP, GLSL shaders.
- **Description**: An isometric 3D bedroom scene rendered in WebGL featuring interactive camera controls, baked ambient lighting textures, dynamic computer screens playing video streams, and responsive 3D objects.

### 2. Infinite World
- **URL**: https://bhavishyasingla.com/world
- **Source**: https://github.com/brunosimon/infinite-world
- **Technology**: Three.js, Vite, Simplex noise algorithms.
- **Description**: A procedurally generated infinite terrain explorer where users navigate a limitless mathematical landscape in real-time with pointer lock and view mode controls.

### 3. Playground (/folio)
- **URL**: https://bhavishyasingla.com/folio
- **Source**: https://github.com/brunosimon/folio-2019 (MIT License)
- **Technology**: Three.js, Vite, Cannon.js physics engine, Howler audio.
- **Description**: An interactive 3D physics playground where visitors drive a physics-based toy car through a virtual landscape, bumping into objects, triggering interactive elements, and experiencing spatial sound.

## Technical Architecture
- **Framework**: Minimalist Vanilla HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript with Vite tooling.
- **Performance**: Zero Three.js libraries are initialized on homepage load. 3D environments are mounted dynamically on-demand inside an isolated full-viewport stage and unmounted upon exit to release GPU memory and audio resources.
- **SEO & Search Standards**: Compliant with Google Search Essentials, RFC 9309 robots.txt, Schema.org JSON-LD structured data, and Core Web Vitals targets.
